# repointxt Technical Specification (llms-full.txt)
# Engineered by Corbit Technologies (https://www.corbittechnologies.com/)
# Application: https://repointxt.corbit.tech/
# Source Code: https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt

## 1. System Overview
repointxt is a 100% browser-based developer utility that ingests local directories or remote GitHub repositories and formats their AST-filtered, signal-dense contents into structured prompt context for Large Language Models (LLMs).

Unlike conventional server-side proxies (such as repo2txt or gitingest), repointxt processes all files, tokens, and credentials in the browser's local sandbox memory using Web Crypto, the File System Access API, and client-side JSZip decompression. No repository code, tokens, or personal data are ever uploaded to remote servers.

---

## 2. Target Context Windows & Token Limit Specifications
repointxt provides calibrated sliders and context budgeting presets tailored to leading foundation models:

- **Claude 5.5 Opus / Sonnet / Haiku (Anthropic):** 1M / 200K / 100K tokens (presets: 1M, 200K Agentic, 100K)
- **Gemini 4 Argon / 3.8 Flash (Google):** 1M tokens (preset: 1M)
- **GPT-6 Astra / 6.1 Sol (OpenAI):** 1.05M / 272K tier (presets: 1M, 272K tier)
- **DeepSeek-V4.1:** 1M tokens (preset: 1M)

When total codebase tokens exceed the target context window, repointxt performs deterministic multi-part chunking. Each chunk preserves architectural topology metadata, full tree manifests, and partial code listings with cross-chunk continuity directives.

---

## 3. Client-Side Privacy Guarantees
1. **Zero-Knowledge Architecture:** No backend storage, proxy caching, or intermediary servers.
2. **In-Memory ZIP Unpacking:** Remote GitHub ZIP tarballs are downloaded directly from GitHub APIs to the client browser and unpacked strictly inside WebAssembly/JavaScript memory via JSZip.
3. **Local File System Access:** Local folders are opened via the HTML5 File System Access API without transmitting disk content across the network.
4. **Credential Isolation:** GitHub Personal Access Tokens (PATs) used to bypass GitHub rate limits are stored only in `localStorage` in the user's browser, used strictly in direct client-to-`api.github.com` fetch calls.

---

## 4. Prompt Bundle Output Syntax & Schema
Codebase context generated by repointxt follows an XML-enclosed, CDATA-delimited structure designed for high comprehension in frontier LLMs:

```xml
<codebase_context
  tool="repointxt by Corbit Technologies"
  github="https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt"
  generated_at="2026-10-14T12:00:00.000Z"
  part="1"
  total_parts="1">
  <overview>
    <framework_topology detected="Turborepo Monorepo, Next.js (App Router)" count="42">
      <route_map>
        • /
        • /dashboard
        • /settings
      </route_map>
    </framework_topology>
    <selected_files_count>42</selected_files_count>
    <manifest>
      • package.json (~120 tokens)
      • src/App.tsx (~340 tokens)
      • src/main.tsx (~90 tokens)
    </manifest>
  </overview>

  <file path="src/App.tsx" boundary="client" language="tsx" tokens="~340">
<![CDATA[
// Sanitized, AST-optimized code content here
]]>
  </file>

  <instructions>
    - Reference exact file paths from <file path="..."> when analyzing or citing code.
    - Base all recommendations strictly on the implementation patterns provided above.
    - Avoid leaving placeholder comments like '// ... rest of code' when suggesting edits.
  </instructions>
</codebase_context>
```

### Tag Explanations:
- `<codebase_context>`: Root enclosure specifying tool metadata, timestamp, and chunk part index.
- `<overview>`: Contains framework topology summaries, detected routing structures, monorepo configurations, and the file manifest.
- `<manifest>`: Complete list of all selected files in the codebase bundle alongside approximate token counts ("Map-Before-Territory" pattern).
- `<file path="..." language="..." tokens="...">`: Individual source code files enclosed within `<![CDATA[ ... ]]>` tags. Handles boundary directives (e.g., `boundary="client"` for Next.js App Router components).
- `<instructions>`: Recency-bias anchor placed at the bottom of the prompt to enforce file path citations and avoid truncation hallucinations.

---

## 5. Automated URL Ingestion Routing
- Append any public GitHub repository slug to the repointxt domain to automatically trigger client-side ingestion:
  - `https://repointxt.corbit.tech/owner/repo`
  - `https://repointxt.corbit.tech/github.com/owner/repo`
- URL Parameter Context Presets:
  - `?model=claude` -> sets context window to 1,000,000 tokens
  - `?model=gemini` -> sets context window to 1,000,000 tokens
  - `?model=gpt6` -> sets context window to 1,000,000 tokens
